name: fastapi-auth-validation
explain: Demonstrate FastAPI-style ASGI request routing, Pydantic schema validation, and dependency-injected authorization. Enforces 422 Unprocessable Entity on schema violations and 401/403 on authorization failure before business handlers execute.
steps: Authenticate user credentials and enforce multi-tenant authorization in a dependency function. || Validate payload types and numeric boundaries with Pydantic schema validation, returning structured 422 errors.
expect: FastAPI validation & auth verified: valid=201, invalid_schema=422, cross_tenant=403

name: http-request-lifecycle
explain: Trace an HTTPS request from domain input to response: recursive DNS resolution, TCP 3-way handshake, TLS 1.3 cryptographic key exchange, and HTTP/2 wire framing.
steps: Resolve domain name to server IP address through DNS. || Establish TCP transport and TLS 1.3 encrypted session before dispatching HTTP application request frames.
expect: HTTPS request trace verified: total_latency=117ms, phases=['DNS', 'TCP_HANDSHAKE', 'TLS_1_3', 'TTFB']

name: http-safe-idempotent-methods
explain: Differentiate safe methods (GET), idempotent methods (PUT, DELETE), and non-idempotent methods (POST). Demonstrates using Idempotency-Key headers to make POST requests safely retriable without duplicate record creation.
steps: Demonstrate duplicate resource creation when repeating a non-idempotent POST without an idempotency key. || Attach Idempotency-Key header to return cached creation results on network retries.
expect: HTTP method semantics verified: duplicate_post=doc_2, idempotent_retried=doc_3

name: http-status-codes-problem-details
explain: Implement the RFC 9457 Problem Details error contract across standard HTTP status codes: 400 Bad Request, 401 Unauthorized, 403 Forbidden, 404 Not Found, and 422 Unprocessable Entity.
steps: Format machine-readable problem detail envelopes with error types, titles, and invalid parameter breakdowns. || Map distinct client, authentication, and validation failure modes to appropriate HTTP status codes.

name: cors-preflight-defense
explain: Demonstrate Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) preflight OPTIONS negotiation. Proves that CORS is a browser sandbox policy, not a server firewall, showing why API authentication is mandatory.
steps: Handle preflight OPTIONS request and return Access-Control-Allow-Origin headers for trusted origins. || Demonstrate that non-browser clients (curl, backend scripts) bypass CORS headers, requiring server-side Bearer authentication.
expect: CORS security boundary verified: preflight_allowed=204, preflight_blocked=403, curl_bypass_handled=200

name: cookie-sessions-vs-bearer-tokens
explain: Compare Cookie-based session storage against Bearer tokens. Cookies provide HttpOnly protection against XSS but require Anti-CSRF defense; Bearer tokens are immune to CSRF but vulnerable to XSS exfiltration if stored in localStorage.
steps: Simulate cross-site request forgery attack on auto-attached session cookies and block it via Anti-CSRF verification. || Authenticate requests via Authorization Bearer headers to demonstrate CSRF immunity.
expect: Auth trust boundaries verified: cookie_csrf_blocked=403, bearer_authenticated=200

name: keyset-cursor-pagination-api
explain: Implement stable Keyset cursor pagination in REST APIs using base64-encoded (created_at, id) tuples. Prevents page drift and duplicate items when records are inserted concurrently.
steps: Encode the last record's coordinates into an opaque base64 cursor string. || Seek directly to next page coordinates using cursor predicates, verifying zero duplicate records under concurrent inserts.
expect: Keyset pagination verified: page_1=[16, 17, 18, 19, 20], page_2=[11, 12, 13, 14, 15], zero_overlap=True

name: http-client-retry-backoff
explain: Implement a production-grade HTTP client retry policy. Honors Retry-After headers and applies exponential backoff with full jitter on 429 and 503, while failing fast on non-retriable 400, 401, 403, and 404 errors.
steps: Retry rate-limited 429 requests using parsed Retry-After header and exponential backoff within a deadline budget. || Fail immediately on permanent client errors (401 Unauthorized) without making wasteful retries.
expect: HTTP retry client verified: retried_429_succeeded=200 in 3 tries; 401_fail_fast=401 in 1 try

name: http-wire-parsing-router
explain: Parse raw HTTP/1.1 TCP byte streams into standard ASGI scope dictionaries. Demonstrates how servers parse request-lines, headers, and query parameters before routing into web frameworks.
steps: Split TCP stream on CRLF boundaries to parse method, request path, HTTP version, and headers. || Construct standard ASGI HTTP scope dictionary containing normalized headers and query parameters.
expect: HTTP wire parsing verified: method=POST, path=/api/v1/inference, body_bytes=27
